solutions.check: 30 entries, 60 crossings, 0 conflicts; answers matched to the grid by number, direction and length

clue.text: Defect starts with it

parts.note: starts as a verb, flinches or leaps in surprise, means jumps
'it' in the sense of fashionable, the in thing, is hip

explanation.surface: A defect, in the sense of a flaw, that starts out with something.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Defect' reads as a noun, a flaw, but it is the verb: to desert. 'it' here is the old slang for fashionable.
explanation.definitionFit: To desert one's post or side, like a sailor leaving a vessel unlawfully, is the idiom for defecting.

clue.text: Man in the street couple upset with short jibe

indicators.note: upset signals that these letters are thrown into disorder
short means the last letter of jibe is cut off

explanation.surface: An ordinary passer-by, a couple upset by a cutting remark.
explanation.definitionFit: Both phrases are idioms for an ordinary average citizen, a typical member of the public.

clue.text: Part of US motorway that is restricting width

parts.note: M is the British abbreviation for motorway, as in the M1

indicators.note: restricting means hemming in, so the Latin phrase holds the next letter

parts.note: id est is Latin for that is, abbreviated i.e.

explanation.surface: An American highway that narrows its lanes.
explanation.definitionFit: The region of the north-central United States, such as Iowa and Ohio, is one part of the country.

clue.text: Evangelist in street with couple — for one hour

indicators.note: for means one letter stands in place of the other

parts.note: to couple is to join
I is the Roman numeral for one

explanation.surface: A preacher out on the street with a pair of people for an hour.
explanation.definitionFit: The writer of the fourth Gospel, one of the four Evangelists named after their Gospels.

clue.text: Fan at home ground feisty, note

parts.note: in means at home

indicators.note: ground as in milled or crushed, so the letters are broken up and remade

explanation.surface: A supporter at their home ground, feisty, taking notes.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Fan' looks like a supporter at a ground, but it is the verb, as in fanning flames.
explanation.definitionFit: To fan flames or passions is to make them stronger, the verb sense of increasing.

clue.text: Hear rally vehicle

definitions.meaning: to receive a signal or catch news, as a radio does
to recover or improve, as a patient or a market does

explanation.surface: An order to listen out for a rally car.
explanation.definitionFit: Three senses: catching a signal, recovering strength, and a light truck with an open load bed.

clue.text: Rosemary, maybe, is lead: different parts

indicators.note: parts means splits, so the symbol for lead is divided by the word for different

parts.note: Pb is the chemical symbol for lead
different means other

explanation.surface: Rosemary, the name, playing the lead with different parts, like a casting decision.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Rosemary' reads as a woman's name with a lead role, but it is the herb.
explanation.definitionFit: A culinary herb, one used in cooking: rosemary is an example.

clue.text: Ends of cloth, poorly cut, unwound

indicators.note: ends of points to the first and last letters of the word cloth

parts.note: poorly means ill
axed means cut, as of jobs or spending

explanation.surface: The edges of a cloth, badly cut and unravelled.
explanation.walkthrough: 'unwound' looks like unravelled thread; it is relaxed. The answer is modern slang blending chill and relax.
explanation.definitionFit: A slang verb for relaxing, so a person chilled out has unwound.

clue.text: Hungry teens discarding wrappers harmful to the environment

indicators.note: discarding wrappers strips away the outer letter from each end of both words

explanation.surface: Hungry teenagers dropping litter that harms the environment.
explanation.definitionFit: Not green in the eco-friendly sense, so damaging to the natural world.

clue.text: Religious festival a thing cast turns to

indicators.note: turns tells us to read the word for a thing cast from back to front

parts.note: a die is cast, as in 'the die is cast'

explanation.surface: A religious festival that moves to a cast figure, perhaps a statue.
explanation.definitionFit: The Muslim festival marking the end of Ramadan, or the feast of sacrifice, is called by this name.

clue.text: Becoming hard to follow raven, flying all over

indicators.note: to follow places the word for becoming hard after the colour word

parts.note: raven as a colour is glossy black, like jet
concrete or jelly setting is becoming hard

explanation.surface: Something growing hard to track as a raven flies everywhere.
explanation.definitionFit: Members of a wealthy set flying around the world between fashionable resorts are said to be jet-setting.

clue.text: Unearth unusual energy compound

indicators.note: unusual signals the letters before it are arranged in a different way

parts.note: E is the physics symbol for energy

explanation.surface: Digging up an unusual energy compound.
explanation.definitionFit: A chemical compound, the ethyl ester of carbamic acid, also the base of polyurethane plastics.

clue.text: Female nominee lies about cases

indicators.note: about turns the hidden run round to read the other way
cases means encloses, so the letters are held inside the words nominee lies

explanation.surface: A nominee lying about the cases put forward, perhaps in court.
explanation.walkthrough: 'cases' takes NEELIE from inside 'nomiNEE LIEs'; 'about' then turns it round.
explanation.definitionFit: A woman's given name, so it can stand for a female in crossword terms.

clue.text: Something to draw a crowd?

definitions.meaning: straws or slips drawn to decide a matter by chance
a great many, as in '... of people'

explanation.surface: A crowd-puller, an attraction.
explanation.definitionFit: One draws these to settle things by chance, and the word also means a great many.

clue.text: Belt all there is to go around minute top

indicators.note: to go around means the first word encircles what follows

parts.note: to be all there is to be sane
a brow is the top, as of a hill

explanation.surface: A belt that is long enough to fit round a tiny top.
explanation.walkthrough: A Sam Browne is a military belt with a strap over the right shoulder, worn by British army officers.
explanation.definitionFit: An officer's belt with a supporting shoulder strap, named after its inventor, a British general.

clue.text: Thrill provided by corner — good for the sport

parts.note: a kick is a thrill, as in 'get a kick out of'
to corner someone is to box them in

explanation.surface: The excitement a corner gives, good for the game, as in football.
explanation.definitionFit: A combat sport in which fighters may strike with feet as well as fists.

clue.text: Cheap blue slate covers

indicators.note: covers means sits on top of, so in this down entry the word for slate comes above

parts.note: to slate is to criticise harshly, to knock
blue means sad, down

explanation.surface: Inexpensive blue slate for covering a roof.
explanation.walkthrough: 'slate' suggests roofing stone; it is the verb, to criticise.
explanation.definitionFit: A knockdown price is a much reduced one, so the word means cheap.

clue.text: Ancient blazer's given awful grief, possessing smell

indicators.note: possessing means holding within, so the rearranged letters hold the smell word
awful signals that the letters of grief are jumbled

parts.note: to reek is to smell strongly

explanation.surface: An old blazer, the jacket, causing terrible grief because of its smell.
explanation.walkthrough: 'blazer' suggests a jacket, but it is something that blazes. 'awful' rearranges the five letters to split around the smell word.
explanation.definitionFit: A Byzantine incendiary weapon, a burning liquid used in ancient and medieval sea battles.

clue.text: Primate digests long, reflective section of bible, smoking pipe

indicators.note: digests means takes inside, so the primate swallows the next piece

parts.note: a chimp is a primate

indicators.note: reflective tells us the word for long is mirrored, read right to left

parts.note: to long for is to have a yen
OT is the Old Testament

explanation.surface: A monkey taking in a long thoughtful passage of scripture while puffing a pipe.
explanation.definitionFit: The pipe on a roof through which chimney smoke escapes, so a smoking pipe in a literal sense.

clue.text: City strict about protecting its location

indicators.note: protecting means guarding inside, so the phrase for strict surrounds the next piece

parts.note: to be hot on something is to be strict about it
the city is located in the US

explanation.surface: A city being strict about guarding where it is.
explanation.definitionFit: A Texas city, the fourth largest in the United States.

clue.text: European was granted late wish in act of self-promotion

parts.note: got means was given or granted
RIP, rest in peace, is a wish for the late, the dead

explanation.surface: A European granted a dying wish in an act of self-promotion.
explanation.walkthrough: 'late' means dead: RIP is the wish made for the deceased.
explanation.definitionFit: A self-indulgent venture undertaken chiefly to boost one's own image or vanity.

clue.text: May constituents, perhaps, when speaking, impart such confusion?

indicators.note: when speaking says the answer is heard like the word for May's parts

parts.note: the month of May is made up of 31 days

explanation.surface: Wondering whether certain voters, in May elections, speak in muddled terms.
explanation.walkthrough: 'May constituents' looks like voters, but May is the month, made up of days.
explanation.definitionFit: Being dazed is being stunned and bewildered, a state of confusion.

clue.text: Lake that's divided as expanse has contracted

definitions.text: Lake that's divided as expanse has contracted

indicators.note: has contracted is read as has taken in, so the expanse holds the rest

parts.note: an area is an expanse

indicators.note: divided means the lake letter splits the little word as

explanation.surface: A lake that has been split in two as its water area shrank.
explanation.walkthrough: The whole clue is both definition and wordplay: 'has contracted' reads as has taken on; on the surface it means shrank.
explanation.definitionFit: The Central Asian lake shrank drastically through irrigation and is now split into separate basins.

clue.text: Lots of surgery after lifting boy released from trap

definitions.note: let out of the mouth, trap being slang for mouth; a past participle

indicators.note: after places the boy's name following the turned-up word
lifting in a down entry means the word is raised, read from bottom to top

parts.note: ops, short for operations, are lots of surgery
Ken is a boy's name

explanation.surface: A boy freed from a trap after many operations.
explanation.walkthrough: 'trap' looks like a snare, but it is slang for the mouth: words released from it have been uttered.
explanation.definitionFit: Words let out of the mouth have been said aloud, trap being informal for mouth.

clue.text: Size of book drawing in a companion of status, often

indicators.note: in puts the word for drawing inside the companion word

parts.note: status is often followed by quo, as in status quo
drawing is a kind of art

explanation.surface: Size of a book that includes a picture of a high-status companion.
explanation.definitionFit: A book size made by folding sheets twice to give four leaves, a standard printing format.

clue.text: Fish out of refuse container small ball

parts.note: a skip is a large open rubbish container, the British term for a dumpster
the jack is the small target ball in bowls

explanation.surface: A fish pulled from a rubbish bin along with a little ball.
explanation.walkthrough: A skip is the British word for a builder's rubbish container; in bowls, players aim at a small ball called the jack.
explanation.definitionFit: A type of tuna, the skipjack, found in warm seas.

clue.text: Drag performer by bar getting big build-up?

parts.note: something that drags, such as a truck pulling a car, is a tower
to bar is to block

explanation.surface: A drag queen by a bar getting a big build-up.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Drag performer' suggests a drag act, but it is one who tows.
explanation.definitionFit: A tall building of many storeys, a large construction built upwards: playfully, a big build-up.

clue.text: Journey to Pole? How one often ends

definitions.meaning: to travel over snow on runners, as an explorer might on the way to the Pole
a Pole's surname often has the ending of Kowalski or Wisniewski

explanation.surface: Wondering about a trip to the Pole and how one tends to finish.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Pole' reads as the polar region, but in the second sense it is a Polish person.
explanation.definitionFit: Polar explorers often travel on skis, and many Polish surnames have the ending -ski.

clue.text: Partial decimalisation for sure very involved

indicators.note: in British decimalisation the old penny, d, was replaced by the new penny, p; done here to only one of the d's

parts.note: indeed means for sure, certainly

explanation.surface: Someone caught up in the partial decimalisation of a currency.
explanation.walkthrough: In 1971 Britain's currency went decimal: the old penny, written d, gave way to the new penny, written p. Only one D of INDEED changes.
explanation.definitionFit: Being caught up deeply in something, often trouble, is the idiom for being very involved.

clue.text: Romantic meeting at pub interfered with by mid-January flood

indicators.note: interfered with by means the pub has a letter pushed into it

parts.note: an inn is a pub

indicators.note: mid takes the central letter of the month name

parts.note: a date is a romantic meeting

explanation.surface: A romantic meeting at a pub disrupted in the middle of January by flooding.
explanation.definitionFit: To flood is to overwhelm with water; the synonym also covers being swamped with letters or calls.
